meta.method: Extraído del payload Next.js de /models/<slug> y /evaluations
notes: El slug base es el effort por defecto: max en Claude y GPT (p.ej. claude-opus-5-5, gpt-6-1-sol), high en Gemini 4 Carbon.
aa3dElo, code2videoElo y personalityBench solo existen para algunas variantes (sobre todo max).
time_per_task_s = tokens de salida por tarea / velocidad de salida.

artificial-analysis-intelligence-index.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0.1
artificial-analysis-intelligence-index.summary: A composite benchmark aggregating nine challenging evaluations to provide a holistic measure of AI capabilities across knowledge work, coding, science, and general knowledge.

aa-briefcase.name: AA-Briefcase v1.1
aa-briefcase.summary: A private evaluation developed by Artificial Analysis for frontier agentic capability in long-horizon knowledge work, testing agents on realistic business workflows that require deliverables such as spreadsheets, presentations, and memos.

aa-3d.name: AA-3D
aa-3d.summary: A benchmark developed by Artificial Analysis for how well AI models build interactive 3D experiences. Models work as agents in an offline sandbox via Stirrup to turn a written brief into a three.js scene, with Elo ratings derived from blind pairwise votes.

apex-agents-aa.name: APEX-Agents-AA
apex-agents-aa.summary: Artificial Analysis' implementation of the APEX-Agents benchmark, testing AI agents on long-horizon, cross-application tasks in professional-services environments with realistic application tooling.

aa-analyst-agent.name: AA-AnalystAgent
aa-analyst-agent.summary: Artificial Analysis' data analysis benchmark, testing AI agents on their ability to work with spreadsheets and documents to answer quantitative questions a Business Analyst or Data Analyst would face day-to-day.

automationbench-aa.name: AutomationBench-AA
automationbench-aa.summary: A benchmark measuring agentic task completion across simulated SaaS application environments, scoring the share of each task's objectives completed without guardrail violations.

harvey-lab-aa.name: Harvey LAB-AA v1.1
harvey-lab-aa.summary: Artificial Analysis' implementation of Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), testing AI agents on real-world legal work from Harvey's dataset of 120 private tasks spanning 24 legal practice areas. v1.1, built in collaboration with Harvey, checks every deliverable against the task's source documents for hallucinations, so work that passes every rubric criterion but contains a material hallucination receives no credit. A panel of three judges grades each deliverable criterion-by-criterion.

gdp-pdf.name: GDP.pdf
gdp-pdf.summary: Artificial Analysis' implementation of Surge AI's GDP.pdf benchmark, testing whether language models can reason over long, real-world professional documents and satisfy detailed task-specific criteria.

enterprise-ops-gym-aa.name: EnterpriseOps-Gym-AA
enterprise-ops-gym-aa.summary: Artificial Analysis' independent implementation of ServiceNow's EnterpriseOps-Gym, an agentic benchmark testing whether LLM agents can complete stateful, multi-step enterprise workflows across eight business domains via live tool use, graded on the final state of the underlying databases.

terminalbench-4-0.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
terminalbench-4-0.summary: A harder 66-task benchmark of complex terminal work across software, machine learning, science, operations, security, hardware, and media, with recalibrated compute and time allowances and improved instructions, environments, and verifiers.

terminal-bench-science.name: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1
terminal-bench-science.summary: A 70-task benchmark of research workflows authored and reviewed by domain experts across the life, physical, earth, mathematical, and engineering sciences, each completed in a terminal and checked by its own set of tests.

frontiercode-2-0.name: FrontierCode-AA 2.0
frontiercode-2-0.summary: Artificial Analysis' implementation of Cognition's FrontierCode 2.0, a private agentic coding benchmark of 132 tasks in real open-source repositories, graded on whether a maintainer would merge the agent's change.

hle-diamond.name: HLE-Diamond
hle-diamond.summary: A refined and updated 1,000-question set of Humanity's Last Exam, split evenly between reasoning and knowledge questions, with 272 questions that include an image.

aa-personalitybench.name: AA-PersonalityBench
aa-personalitybench.summary: Measures how models communicate rather than whether they are correct: 30 judged personality traits rolled up into 8 indexes, plus 21 measured communication characteristics.

omniscience.name: AA-Omniscience v1.1
omniscience.summary: A benchmark measuring factual recall and hallucination across various economically relevant domains.

gpqa-diamond.name: GPQA Diamond
gpqa-diamond.summary: The most challenging 198 questions from GPQA, where PhD experts achieve 65% accuracy but skilled non-experts only reach 34% despite web access.

itbench-aa.name: ITBench-AA
itbench-aa.summary: Artificial Analysis' implementation of IBM's ITBench benchmark, testing AI agents on Kubernetes incident root-cause analysis from offline incident snapshots. The agent inspects alerts, events, traces, and topology and identifies the contributing-factor entities (deployments, pods, namespaces, network policies, etc.) responsible for the failure.

mmmu-pro.name: MMMU-Pro
mmmu-pro.summary: An enhanced MMMU benchmark that eliminates shortcuts and guessing strategies to more rigorously test multimodal models across 30 academic disciplines.

ifbench.name: IFBench
ifbench.summary: A benchmark evaluating precise instruction-following generalization on 58 diverse, verifiable out-of-domain constraints that test models' ability to follow specific output requirements.

mlcr-aa.name: MLCR-AA
mlcr-aa.summary: An open benchmark from Wisedocs measuring how well models reason over long, fragmented medical records, performing the multi-document synthesis claims professionals rely on when reviewing insurance and healthcare cases.

code2video-aa.name: Code2Video-AA
code2video-aa.summary: Artificial Analysis' implementation of HeyGen's Code2Video Bench, evaluating how well models create short product and brand videos from 114 design briefs using HyperFrames HTML.

healthbench.name: HealthBench
healthbench.summary: OpenAI's HealthBench: 5,000 health conversations graded against physician-written rubrics, from emergency referrals to global health.

critpt-v2.name: CritPt v2
critpt-v2.summary: CritPt v2 is the revised version of CritPt, a benchmark designed to test LLMs on research-level physics reasoning tasks, featuring 70 composite research challenges. Models solve problems with a code-execution tool in an offline Linux sandbox.

vials-aa.name: VIALS-AA
vials-aa.summary: VIALS-AA is Artificial Analysis' implementation of Handshake AI's VIALS benchmark. It tests whether language models can interpret scientific images and answer questions about the evidence they contain.

mka.name: MKA
mka.summary: Artificial Analysis' implementation of Google DeepMind's Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark. It tests whether agents can read visually dense project files, such as architectural drawings, engineering schematics and clinical scans, and produce the deliverables a professional would.

gdpval-aa.name: GDPval-AA v2.1
gdpval-aa.summary: GDPval-AA v2.1 is Artificial Analysis' evaluation framework for OpenAI's GDPval dataset. It tests AI models on real-world tasks across 44 occupations and 9 major industries. Models are given shell access and web browsing capabilities in an agentic loop via Stirrup to solve tasks, with Elo ratings derived from blind pairwise comparisons.

tau3-banking.name: 𝜏³-Banking
tau3-banking.summary: A fintech customer-support benchmark from the 𝜏-Knowledge framework that tests whether agents can navigate a large unstructured knowledge base and execute multi-step tool calls to resolve realistic banking workflows.

terminalbench-2-1.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
terminalbench-2-1.summary: A verified refresh of Terminal-Bench 2.0: 89 curated tasks across software engineering, system administration, data processing, model training, and security, with environment and instruction fixes so scores reflect agent capability rather than environment gaps.

frontiercode.name: FrontierCode 1.1
frontiercode.summary: Artificial Analysis' implementation of Cognition's FrontierCode 1.1, a private agentic coding benchmark that tests models on completing coding tasks in a way that would actually get merged by maintainers of real-world repositories.

artificial-analysis-long-context-reasoni.name: AA-LCR v1.1
artificial-analysis-long-context-reasoni.summary: A challenging benchmark measuring language models' ability to extract, reason about, and synthesize information from long-form documents ranging from 10k to 100k tokens (measured using the cl100k_base tokenizer).

scicode.name: SciCode
scicode.summary: A scientist-curated coding benchmark featuring 288 test set subproblems from 80 laboratory problems across 16 scientific disciplines.

humanitys-last-exam.name: Humanity's Last Exam
humanitys-last-exam.summary: A frontier-level benchmark with 2,500 expert-vetted questions across mathematics, sciences, and humanities, designed to be the final closed-ended academic evaluation.

critpt.name: CritPt
critpt.summary: A benchmark designed to test LLMs on research-level physics reasoning tasks, featuring 71 composite research challenges.

terminalbench-hard.name: Terminal-Bench Hard
terminalbench-hard.summary: An agentic benchmark evaluating AI capabilities in terminal environments through software engineering, system administration, and data processing tasks.

tau2-bench.name: 𝜏²-Bench Telecom
tau2-bench.summary: A dual-control conversational AI benchmark simulating technical support scenarios where both agent and user must coordinate actions to resolve telecom service issues.

mmlu-pro.name: MMLU-Pro
mmlu-pro.summary: An enhanced version of MMLU with 12,000 graduate-level questions across 14 subject areas, featuring ten answer options and deeper reasoning requirements.

livecodebench.name: LiveCodeBench
livecodebench.summary: A contamination-free coding benchmark that continuously harvests fresh competitive programming problems from LeetCode, AtCoder, and CodeForces, evaluating code generation, self-repair, and execution.

math-500.name: MATH-500
math-500.summary: A 500-problem subset from the MATH dataset, featuring competition-level mathematics across six domains including algebra, geometry, and number theory.

aime-2025.name: AIME 2025
aime-2025.summary: All 30 problems from the 2025 American Invitational Mathematics Examination, testing olympiad-level mathematical reasoning with integer answers from 000-999.

global-mmlu-lite.name: Global-MMLU-Lite
global-mmlu-lite.summary: A lightweight, multilingual version of MMLU, designed to evaluate knowledge and reasoning skills across a diverse range of languages and cultural contexts.

domain_indices.name: Finance & Accounting Index
domain_indices.description: Assesses model performance across the finance and accounting domain. Capabilities evaluated include domain-specific knowledge (accounting, investments, corporate and markets), financial analysis and reporting, compliance and audit, market research, and more.

domain_indices.name: Strategy & Ops Index
domain_indices.description: Assesses model performance across the strategy and operations domain. Capabilities evaluated include domain-specific knowledge (business and management, accounting, corporate and markets), strategy and planning, customer support, records management, and more.

domain_indices.name: Legal Index
domain_indices.description: Assesses model performance across the legal domain. Capabilities evaluated include domain-specific knowledge (contract law, tort law, constitutional law), legal research and drafting, litigation support, compliance review, and more.

domain_indices.name: Healthcare & Medical Index
domain_indices.description: Assesses model performance across the healthcare and medical domain. Capabilities evaluated include domain-specific knowledge (medicine, public health, biomedical sciences), clinical diagnosis and assessment, reasoning over long patient records and claims files, patient documentation, medication management, and more.

domain_indices.name: Engineering Index
domain_indices.description: Assesses model performance across the engineering domain. Capabilities evaluated include domain-specific knowledge (civil, electrical, and mechanical engineering), design and analysis, tooling and automation, technical documentation, and more.

domain_indices.name: Economics Index
domain_indices.description: Assesses model performance across the economics domain. Capabilities evaluated include domain-specific knowledge (microeconomics, macroeconomics, public finance), analysis and forecasting, research synthesis, quantitative modeling, and more.
